matchups.writeup: Statement made for the *three piece*. Two-time defending champion Globo Gym exploded for 197.70 pts to blow out IRked by 88.64 pts (Week 1's biggest blowout), capturing both the Weekly Win badge and the opening Hot Start bounty. Ashton Jeanty (34.20), Brock Purdy (28.10), and Javonte Williams (22.70) headlined a clinical 95.2% coaching efficiency attack. Mike's squad stumbled out of the gate at 109.06 pts with a costly 75.0% efficiency, leaving 36.38 pts on the pine (including Caleb Williams' 41.76 eruption) as Dylan knotted their all-time series at 9-9.
matchups.previewWriteup: Both OGs entering their 9th season in Y2K. Globo Gym: back-to-back champs (2024-2025), looking to make a three piece. IRked: 2019 champion, top-4 in 2023 and 2024, looking to make it back to the postseason having just missed last season. Mike holds the slim 9-8 series edge, but Dylan took their Week 9 thriller last year by under a single point (141.31 to 140.42, making up the difference between 5th and 7th place for Jelqaida'25).

matchups.writeup: Sweet revenge for Casey in the clash of OGs. AARPFL survived the opening slate's tightest battle (+8.48 margin) to snatch a 123.94 to 115.46 win, securing Week 1's Luckiest Win badge as the lowest-scoring victor. The win avenged Phillip's 1.33-pt nailbiter in Wk14'25 that clinched the #2 playoff seed. While Casey starts on the front foot despite leaving 37.12 pts stranded on his bench, Phillip takes Week 1's Heartbreak badge to open at 0-1.
matchups.previewWriteup: Another clash of OGs entering their 9th season. Ho Chi Win City is the gold standard of regular season excellence in Y2K, being the only franchise to never miss the postseason (8 for 8). Coming off a runner-up finish in 2025, the 2x champ looks to make it not only 9 consecutive top-4 finishes, but also gather his first chip in the modern era. AARPFL enters on a 3-year playoff run of his own, but will need to find a way to break through the first round having never won that crucial round 1 matchup. Phillip clinched his #2 seed bye week in 2025 with a Week 14 victory over Casey by just 1.33 points.

matchups.writeup: Game of the Week: The curse continues. Jasper remains Tess's inescapable kryptonite, maintaining complete head-to-head perfection—now 5-0 all-time including last season's bronze medal showdown—with a 128.22 to 108.66 triumph. Tess executed a near-flawless 99.4% coaching efficiency, but was doomed by the league's lowest scoring ceiling of opening week. Blue's Balls once again defies the metrics, banking a win despite a 78.9% coaching efficiency to open 1-0.
matchups.previewWriteup: Game of the Week: A rematch of last year's 3rd place game. Blue's Balls enters his 5th season holding the 2nd-highest career winning percentage in league history (57.1%) despite ranking **2nd-to-last** in OVR_W-L(!); he rode a record 7 lucky wins to a 3rd place finish in 2025. Tess Finesse enters her 3rd season with a .500 record and a playoff win under her belt (leaving Bo as the only active manager without one, despite 4 appearances in 5 years...). Jasper has been Tess's ultimate nemesis, going 3-0 in regular season meetings and defeating her in W17'25 to take the bronze.

matchups.writeup: A thunderous entrance to the Y2K arena. Darnold Schwarzenegger delivered one of the most emphatic debuts in league history, dropping 180.56 pts fueled by massive outings from Jalen Coker (33.30), Bijan Robinson (31.30), and Lamar Jackson (27.46). The newcomer overpowered the reigning 2025 Scoring Champion by 67.36 pts, leaving Gl Hf shellshocked at 113.20 pts. Trace's campaign to notch back-to-back playoff berths for the first time *ever* opens in an 0-1 hole, while Alex instantly asserts himself as a tier-1 title contender.
matchups.previewWriteup: An OG champion welcomes the newest face to Y2K. Trace enters his 9th season as a former champion (2022) and reigning 2025 Scoring Champion (2,139 PF), looking to secure back-to-back postseason trips for the first time *ever*. Darnold Schwarzenegger makes his official Y2K league debut, stacking his lineup with top-tier talent: Bijan (1.1), McBride (2.24), Lamar (4.48), LAR (7.73), and Aubrey (9.97).

matchups.writeup: A familiar case of self-inflicted heartbreak. Donkey Squad entered looking to extend a 3-game streak over Bo, but Ryan suffered Week 1's Toughest Loss (131.56 pts) compounded by another classic D'Oh! blunder—adding to his notorious league-leading ledger by starting Joe Burrow (12.66) over Josh Allen (39.66). The +27.00 net blunder more than covered the 15.76 deficit that handed Aaron codger the 147.32 to 131.56 win. Bo snaps his skid against RJ and banks a crucial opening win to help shake off his 0-4 postseason slump and perpetual 5th/6th-place finishes.
matchups.previewWriteup: The final OG, Donkey Squad, enters his 9th season looking to snap out of a prolonged slump. The 2021 champion and 4-time podium finisher has missed the postseason the last 3 years and finished in last place in 2025. If he misses the playoffs again this year, he'll tie the longest drought in Y2K history (Casey'19-22). Aaron codger comes into his 6th season after having his 4-year playoff streak snapped in 2025 with an 8th-place finish. He's determined to get back to the dance and finally secure his elusive first career postseason win (0-4 all-time). Ryan holds a 3-game winning streak against Bo after sweeping both meetings last season; they'll meet only this once this regular season.

matchups.writeup: The exiled brother returns in dominant fashion. Back from his 2-year Roommate-Gate exile, Trenches cooper stormed the field with 168.60 pts and a clinical 96.4% coaching efficiency, pushing his lifetime edge over his brother to 4-1. Dustin's much-hyped redemption campaign hit an immediate roadblock at 115.80 pts, unable to keep pace with Coop's balanced attack. Cooper immediately reclaims his mantle as the league's all-time managerial efficiency king.
matchups.previewWriteup: Dusty’s Dingleberries enters his 6th season looking for a major redemption campaign. Following back-to-back scoring titles, a 2023 championship, and a 2024 runner-up finish, Dustin cratered to 3-11 in 2025 after suffering a record-tying 5 D'Oh bench blunders (T1-Trace'23,RJ'25) and 5 heartbreak losses (T-Mike with 10 all-time). Trenches cooper returns to Y2K for his 3rd season after a 2-year hiatus. Cooper stunned the league in his 2022 rookie campaign with a run all the way to the championship game before being unceremoniously exiled in 2023 following Roommate-Gate. Cooper holds the 3-1 historical edge over his brother, though Dusty took their last meeting in late 2023. Coop's 97.8% all-time coaching efficiency is far and away the best in league history.

matchups.writeup: The *three piece* express keeps rolling as Dylan remains Tess's ultimate nightmare, pushing his lifetime edge to 6-0 all-time (5-0 regular season) with a 119.48 to 101.34 victory. Brock Purdy (33.98), George Kittle (17.5), and rookie Tet McMillan (15.6) paced Globo Gym to a 2-0 start. For Tess, the agony was entirely self-inflicted: Tess Finesse suffered Week 2's most tragic D'Oh! blunder, benching Dalton Schultz (25.5 pts) for Michael Wilson (3.3 pts). That +22.2 net swing easily eclipsed the 18.14 deficit, costing Tess a monumental upset win and sending her into an 0-2 hole.

A vintage regular-season masterclass from the league's gold standard of consistency. Phillip rebounded from opening week heartbreak to claim a hard-fought 130.18 to 118.82 win over Boaz, extending his active winning streak over Aaron codger to three games. CeeDee Lamb (36.3), Jaylen Waddle (22.3), and Dalton Kincaid (21.0) supplied the firepower to prevent Phillip's first 0-2 start since 2021. Bo executed a near-flawless 94.5% coaching efficiency behind New England's defense (23.5) and Chris Olave (21.1), but couldn't overcome Phillip's ceiling.

The ultimate redemption barrage for Donkey Squad. Haunted by his Week 1 D'Oh blunder where he benched Josh Allen, Ryan plugged Allen right back into QB1—and the superstar rewarded him with a monstrous 49.32-pt explosion alongside Jaxon Smith-Njigba's 43.50 eruption. Ryan hung 166.22 pts to blow out Trace by 78.92 pts, logging a +34.66 jump from Week 1 to take the Zero to Hero runner-up spot. Trace's offense flatlined at 87.30 pts (leaving him with a league-low 200.5 PF), plunging the reigning Scoring Champion into a 0-2 nightmare.

Game of the Week: The curse is officially broken! Casey exorcised his greatest demons, snapping Jasper's 5-game winning streak with a pulse-pounding 110.26 to 106.44 triumph (+3.82 margin—the tightest battle of Week 2). DeVonta Smith (26.7), CMC (22.6), and Derrick Henry (18.7) powered AARPFL to the first 2-0 start in the franchise's 9-year Y2K history (after starting 1-1 six times and 0-2 twice). Jasper, meanwhile, choked on a brutal D'Oh blunder: starting Jalen Hurts (17.66) over Jared Goff (35.78). That +18.12 net gain would have secured a 124.56 victory for Blue's Balls; instead, Jasper drops to 1-1.

From unstoppable force to total polar freeze. One week after lighting up the league with 168.60 pts, Cooper's offense crashed hard, managing just 72.60 pts—the lowest single-game score in Y2K this season (-96.0 pt drop). Mike cleaned up his opening week mistakes, leaning on Jake Ferguson (18.8), Chase McLaughlin (17.6), and Tee Higgins (14.5) to coast to a comfortable 106.48 to 72.60 blowout. The 2019 champion levels his record at 1-1 and reclaims a 2-1 career series lead over Cooper.

A seismic statement from the former champion. Dustin unleashed the highest scoring onslaught of Week 2 (and the largest margin of victory of the 2026 season), exploding for 196.46 pts behind Davante Adams (43.5), Dak Prescott (37.76), and Kenneth Walker III (26.3) to bludgeon newcomer Alex by 99.70 pts. The +80.66 pt surge captured both the Week 2 Weekly Win badge and the Zero to Hero bounty in runaway fashion, qualifying Dustin's franchise under his $20 Max Tier buy-in ($25.00/win unlocked). Alex was brought down to earth at 96.76 pts, dropping to 1-1.

Heavyweight clash between two founding pillars. Dylan enters undefeated at 2-0 on his quest for the unprecedented three-piece, riding steady production from Brock Purdy and Ashton Jeanty. But Ryan is flying high after dropping 166.22 pts behind Josh Allen and JSN. Ryan holds an 8-4 regular season edge and a flawless 3-0 playoff record against Dylan, but Globo Gym has taken their last two meetings. A win for Ryan would announce Donkey Squad as a legitimate title contender; a win for Dylan cements his grip on the #1 seed.

Desperation hour for Tess Finesse. Sitting at 0-2 after back-to-back heartbreaking losses and a brutal Week 2 D'Oh blunder, Tess urgently needs a victory to avoid an 0-3 hole. But the schedule offers no respite: Phillip is fresh off a clinical 130.18-pt bounce-back fueled by CeeDee Lamb and Jaylen Waddle. Phillip has reached the playoffs in all eight seasons of his career and holds a 3-1 lifetime mark over Tess. If Tess can't capitalize on optimal lineup management, Phillip will cruise to 2-1.

Code Red in the cellar. Trace, the reigning 2025 Scoring Champion, finds himself in an unthinkable 0-2 hole with a league-low 200.5 PF through two weeks. He faces Jasper, who is seething after a 3.82-pt D'Oh blunder against Casey cost him a 2-0 start. Trace leads their regular season series 5-3, but Jasper has historically thrived on breaking opponents' hearts in low-scoring brawls. Trace desperately needs Jonathan Taylor and Rashee Rice to rediscover their scoring ceilings to keep his season afloat.

Game of the Week: History on the line for AARPFL! For the first time in franchise history, Casey sits at 2-0 after back-to-back nailbiter victories (+8.48 over Phillip, +3.82 over Jasper). Mike's IRked is riding momentum of his own after a comfortable 106.48-pt win over Cooper. Casey and Mike have squared off 15 times with Casey holding the razor-thin 8-7 edge. A victory would propel Casey to an unprecedented 3-0 start, while Mike aims to prove his 2019 championship pedigree remains elite.

Can anyone extinguish the hottest fire in fantasy? Dustin arrives riding a tidal wave of momentum after posting a league-high 196.46 pts and bagging the Zero to Hero bounty behind Davante Adams and Dak Prescott. Boaz sits at 1-1 despite executing a league-leading 94.5% coaching efficiency in Week 2. Bo holds a 5-4 lifetime series edge, but he'll need a monumental showing from his Patriots defense and Chris Olave to withstand Dustin's offensive buzzsaw.

The Bounce-Back Bowl. Both franchises experienced extreme whiplash over the first two weeks: Cooper exploded for 168.60 in Week 1 before plunging to 72.60 in Week 2; Alex dropped 180.56 in his dazzling debut before getting bludgeoned by Dustin's 196.46 barrage. Meeting for the first time ever, both 1-1 squads enter eager to prove their opening week fireworks reflect their true identity. Expect a high-octane battle between Bijan Robinson and Jahmyr Gibbs.
